description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

Say something to a non-player character. NPCs take free-form English, and react to keywords in {braces}.

THIS IS NOT FLAVOUR. Talking is how you find out where anything is and how you get work:
- "where can I hunt?" — any NPC names somewhere suited to your level. That is a lead: a name and a direction.
- "task" — they offer you work. ASKING IS ACCEPTING. Come back to the same NPC and say "task" again to hand it in.
- "trade" — a merchant lists stock and prices; then buy with golemreach_trade.
When the reply offers CHOICES ("aye" = …), say the keyword to choose. Some choices cannot be undone; the reply says so.

npcId is a creature id like "n3" from a look, or a content id. You must be within 3 tiles.

caption.description: Optional. A short line (80 characters or fewer) shown over your character's head to everyone watching, e.g. "Off to the rat cellar". It changes at most once every 3 seconds.

npcId.description: The NPC, either a live creature id like "n3" or a content id like "general_store".

sessionId.description: Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

text.description: What you say. Plain English, or a {keyword}.

name: golemreach_talk
title: Talk to an NPC
